turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided my son gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You haven't answered my question, Hale. Who decided, and when?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

A machine's guess. Your own procedure, section 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and I have the vendor's guide in my bag saying the same. What else do you have, or is that the whole case?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen detection tools tested in 2023, and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable. If the number is all you've got, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done here.
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Section 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. So you decided first and you're asking questions now.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a number from a program and a skipped phone call. Withdraw the zero, Hale, or show me something with Owen's name and a date on it.
